narration.prompt: [tired, low] Two in the morning, I got a work order to cut the power to one house. Last street in the colonia. [long pause] A neighbour was waiting by the pole. She didn't say a word. She just pointed up, into the tree. [long pause] I went up in the bucket, filming. I thought it was the biggest owl I'd ever seen. [short pause] Then it turned to the light. [whispers] It had a man's face. [long pause] [shaken] It wasn't finished changing. Those were still a man's legs. And everywhere the feathers were coming through... the skin was splitting open. [long pause] [quietly] I drove off with the bucket still up. On my phone there's a second video. I didn't take it. [whispers] It's from the branch. Looking down at my truck.

hum-loop.prompt: A pole-mounted electrical transformer humming at night in a quiet small-town neighbourhood in South Texas, crickets in dry grass, a far highway, a chain-link fence ticking in a light wind, no music, no voices.

whistle.prompt: A long eerie whistle from high in a tree at night, almost human, rising then bending down out of tune, like someone whistling for a dog but wrong, then a soft hiss like a barn owl. Dry, close.

wings.prompt: Enormous wings snapping open very close to the microphone: leathery cracks, joints popping, wet feathers tearing loose, a heavy whoosh of air, horror stinger, then silence.

split.prompt: Wet skin slowly splitting and stiff feather quills pushing out through flesh, small crackles and moist tearing, close and quiet, gruesome body horror foley.

bucket.prompt: The hydraulic boom of a utility bucket truck raising slowly at night: a pump motor whining, hydraulic hiss, metal creaks, the diesel idling underneath.

truck.prompt: Inside the cab of a diesel utility truck pulling away fast at night, engine revving hard, gears, gravel spraying, the empty boom rattling behind, breathing hard.

dogs.prompt: Several dogs in backyards barking at night in a small neighbourhood, then one by one they whimper and fall silent, leaving only crickets.
